# Exercice : le projet minimal

## Fichier jenga de projet et de workspace (`MaSalleWks.jenga`)

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

# MaSalleWks – Jenga Workspace
# Generated by `jenga workspace` on ...

from Jenga import *

with workspace("MaSalleWks"):
    configurations(['Debug', 'Release'])
    targetoses([TargetOS.WINDOWS, TargetOS.LINUX, TargetOS.MACOS])
    targetarchs([TargetArch.X86_64])

    # Project: MaSalle
    with project("MaSalle"):
        windowedapp()
        language("C++")
        location("MaSalle")
        files(["src/**.cpp", "include/**.hpp"])
```
